import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Standardize island names: strip spaces, title case
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric (it may be stored as text)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Remove negative or out‑of‑range values (allowed 170‑235)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric, removing commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    clean_df = clean(df)
    # Sum body mass per species, ignoring missing values
    sums = clean_df.groupby('species', as_index=False)['body_mass_g'].sum()
    # Convert to plain Python dict (species -> total mass as int)
    result = {row['species']: int(row['body_mass_g']) for _, row in sums.iterrows()}
    return result
